column4: computable_statement
at least one aggression print (size >= session q99, floor 3) in [t-60, t)
at least one aggression print on the CANDIDATE'S side in [t-60, t)
at least one aggression print on the OPPOSING side in [t-60, t)
opposing aggressive volume in [t-120,t) >= session q80 AND |dmid| over the window <= 0.05*ATR14 — effort with no result, against the candidate
the last aggression print on the candidate's side got its result: mid moved with it by >= 1 tick within 30s (inside the body)
the last aggression print on the opposing side got NO result: |dmid| < 1 tick within 30s (on the wick)
>= 3 absorbed opposing-side aggression bursts inside one zone band within [t-1800, t) — repeated effort that got no reward
SQUEEZE fired AND the entry mid is within the zone band of the catalyst anchor (the extreme FIRST aggression of the absorbed cluster)
a later aggression attempt in the same zone prints at WORSE prices for the aggressor than the first attempt — 'more aggression joins them at worse prices, which is itself proof of intent'

SQUEEZE, then failure (mid rolls back through the catalyst by >= 4 ticks), then the drive: the prior swing extreme is taken out in the candidate's direction within [t-900, t) and the candidate is on the RETEST of it
SQUEEZE + failure but NO drive/wick-takeout — the creator's named mistake, 'entering on the failure of the squeeze. No, that's not true'
the candidate sits at a level broken within [t-900, t) and price has returned to it, rather than at the break itself
the nearest zone below (long) / above (short) took opposing aggression in [t-600,t) and did not give way by more than 1 tick
session-to-date aggressive volume at the entry price bucket is >= 3.5x one-sided (min 10 lots), against the candidate's side
IMB_350 AND an aggression print at the same price bucket — 'an imbalance only interests me where it sits at the same price as aggression'
in [t-300,t): one side's aggressive volume >= 3.5x the other AND |dmid| <= 0.05*ATR14 — passive absorption on one side, aggressive pressure on the other, at the same price
mid moved >= 0.25*ATR14 in the candidate's direction over [t-300,t) with ZERO aggression prints on the candidate's side — 'no effort on your side at all, just an absence of sellers'
ORDERED: opposing aggression absorbed in [t-600,t-120), THEN own-side aggression arrives in [t-120,t)
both sides show absorbed aggression in [t-600,t) — 'nobody is in control yet and I am waiting for the break'
session CVD at t is on the candidate's side of its own session-to-date median
session CVD at t is AGAINST the candidate's side of its own median — the creator's checklist veto
over [t-1800,t) mid drifted with the candidate by >= 0.15*ATR14 while CVD moved AGAINST it — 'price refusing to drop while the delta record shows no real selling pressure behind the level'
prints/sec in [t-60,t) >= 3x the session-to-date median rate
prints/sec in [t-60,t) <= 0.34x the session-to-date median rate — 'the speed of tape just dies', the passive failure
the candidate is at the FIRST touch of its zone — 'the first touch of a fresh zone is the weakest version of this trade'
the candidate is at the SECOND touch — 'wait for the second test'
the candidate is at the third or later touch — the creator's own published LOSS (ny-am-session.pdf p.6)
the zone's most recent RESOLVED touch (resolved strictly before t) HELD — the memory family
the zone's two most recent resolved touches both HELD
the zone was built by >= 3 aggression prints totalling >= 3x the session's median aggression print — the construction family
aggressive volume into the level is DECREASING across the last three 120s approach windows — 'losing aggression candle by candle, not gaining it'
>= 2 failed attempts to reclaim the prior range boundary against the candidate's side within [t-3600, t)
a <= 0.2*ATR14 range lasting >= 180s ended in the candidate's direction within [t-300, t)
the overnight extreme on the far side of the entry is still untouched this phase and lies between entry and the candidate's direction of travel — 'the level isn't wrong, the timing is'
the initial balance (first 3600s of the NY phase) has been broken in the candidate's direction before t
the session open sits inside the prior session's value area
the entry mid sits inside the session-to-date 70% value area
the entry mid is within 2 ticks of VAH or VAL — the location family
session-to-date POC sits in the TOP third of the session-to-date range
session-to-date POC sits in the BOTTOM third of the range
session-to-date POC sits in the MIDDLE third — compression, no resolution
traded volume in the 1-ATR band BEHIND the entry (the stop side) is in the bottom session quartile — 'below it there is nothing'
